skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the urbanization process, able to analyze various aspects of urbanization in urban and rural development, and issues related to planning activities.
Understand the basics of urban and rural planning, including objectives, requirements, and processes.
Analyze natural and social factors influencing urban and rural planning.
Understand the structure of urban planning, including land use planning, spatial architectural landscape design, and urban design solutions.
Gain a general understanding of the Vietnamese rural society, organizational structures, and methods of rural planning.
Develop communication skills for group work, decision-making, and idea proposal in urban and rural development planning.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to analyze and evaluate urban and rural planning.
Work collaboratively in teams, demonstrating responsibility and professionalism in solving emerging problems.
Demonstrate adaptability to different contexts and take responsibility for advising on urban and rural planning functions.
